ns2:course.label: General Topology
ns2:course.description: Study of topological spaces and maps, including Cartesian products, identifications, connectedness, compactness, uniform spaces, and function spaces. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC or MS: Financial Engineering.
